AnnotationOrigin.description: Source coordinates and resolution evidence, never executable type authority.

AnnotationResolutionReason.description: Why a written entry annotation cannot describe boundary data.

CallableId.description:
A function and its operation context. Authored callbacks retain their defining
Link; build helpers carry the caller's real Link and an exact library ID.

Caption.description:
A step's title and optional description, in the one text domain every
dialect can spell and read back exactly (`K-CAP-005`). A value exists only
once [`Caption::new`] accepted its text; decoding checks it the same way.

description.description:
At most [`CAPTION_DESCRIPTION_BYTES`] of trimmed lines separated by
`\n`, with no blank first or last line and no two blank lines in a
row. Never empty: no description is `None`.

title.description: One non-empty, trimmed line of at most [`CAPTION_TITLE_BYTES`].

CaptionEntry.description:
One caption: its text and what it names, by exactly one of `site`,
`param` and `field`.

Captions.description:
The captions of one document, by target: strictly ascending and unique,
each a target the document of identity `document` lets a caption name. It is
separate from the [`crate::SourceMap`]: captions outlive the source bytes
a map is keyed to. A host holds workflow captions; extracted cell function
values carry their statement captions.

Decoding checks the order; validate a decoded value against its document
before using its targets.

CaptureValue.description:
Data within a frozen environment, including recursive callable references.
References have meaning only within the enclosing FunctionValue graph.

CarryWire.description:
A carried session as it crosses (S8): its [`SessionRoot`] in the
kernel's token encoding, and a link for each page it names, in its
order (heap, bindings, functions). The receiver authorizes every page
by its link; a root naming a page with none is refused.

Datum.description:
A value copied across the effect boundary: an effect argument, an effect
result, a host read's answer, a run's result (`K-EFF-002`).

A datum is a tree. It has no identity and no cycle; an object reached
twice in the run is written twice.

oneOf.description:
A number not yet decoded: an effect result's JSON number
(`K-EFF-005`). A run never writes one out.

A function a run handed to a tool, frozen as a self-contained
document (`K-EFF-002`). It only leaves a run: it is immutable
snapshot data, and nothing decodes it back into one.

ErrorDatum.description: An error value copied across the effect boundary.

FieldPath.description:
A walk from a parameter's or the result's type to a named record field.
Each step names a field of a record. A list is walked to its element
type, and a union whose members other than null and absent are exactly
one is walked to that member, so `items.title` names the `title` of each
record of a list `items`, and `reply.note` the `note` of an optional
`reply`. A map, a set, a tuple, a record's rest and a union of two
records are not walked.

oneOf.description: The type of the entry's parameter of this name.
The entry's result type.

FieldTarget.description: A named field of a type an entry's signature states.

FunctionRepresentation.description: How a dialect holds a function as a value.

oneOf.description: The closure itself.

A tuple whose first member is the text `tag` and whose member at
`callable` is the closure. The tuple crosses as one function value.

FunctionTarget.description: A convention helper local to this document or named by an explicit Import slot.

FunctionValue.description:
A callable and frozen captures, retaining the defining Link.
The receiving host must validate retained execution provenance before admission.

implicit_text_conversions.description: Source evidence used when this callable becomes a saved workflow.

signature_origin.description: Source coordinates for diagnostics, independent of executable identity.

token.description: Token members other than its callable slot, which is Null.

written_signature.description: The source spelling retained for display, independent of admission evidence.

Handle.description:
A typed reference to a host resource or a host projection. The kernel
reads neither field; a host gives them meaning.

id.description: The host's own identifier for the resource.

kind.description: The handle's type, as the type grammar's `Handle("…")` names it.

ImplicitTextConversion.description: One implicit conversion computed before lowering erases the operand's type.

ImportSlot.description: A stable document-local Import coordinate. Names are diagnostic, never dispatch keys.

Name.description:
A variable, parameter or declared-function name.

Any text is a name; the kernel gives none of them meaning. Structural
validation refuses the empty name.

OperationSlot.description:
Disjoint operation namespaces. Helper bodies retain their own local import
slots, but execution identifies their declarations by content.

OperationUse.description:
One authored import or helper operation declaration in one immutable Link.
All dispatch, modes, recorded reads and waited outcomes use this identity.

PageAuthority.description:
What authorizes a capability: the activation's lease on its committed
root, or its private staging.

oneOf.description: A store root lease (S6), by its id.
The activation's stage lease (S5), by its id.

PageCapability.x-lash-binary-encoding: page[32], authority-kind[1] (root=0, stage=1), authority-id[u64-le], epoch[u64-le], mac[32]

x-lash-packed-fields.description:
A parent-issued capability to read one page: bound to its digest, its
authority and the activation epoch, under a MAC whose key never leaves
the parent. It is transport authority, never saved state: a fresh
activation derives new ones from its leased root. On the worker it is
the kernel's opaque 48-byte `PageGrant` (authority 8, epoch 8, MAC 32).

It crosses as its [`PAGE_CAPABILITY_BYTES`] fixed bytes, a page's
worth of them per page every exchange names (FIG-6321): the digest, the
authority's kind and id, the epoch and the MAC; in a human-readable
payload, as those bytes in hex.

PageLink.description:
How a carried session names one of its pages: under a capability the
receiver verifies, or as a page of the seal batch the same frame
carries, which the parent admits into this activation's staging before
it reads the session (FIG-6288).

optional.description:
The argument may be omitted, and is then absent (`K-FN-004`). No
required parameter follows an optional one.

ParamTarget.description:
A declared function's parameter, by name. An entry's parameters are
its signature's, the names a host starts it with; another function's are
its own.

RecordRest.description: A record either refuses, discards, or retains undeclared fields.

rest.description: What happens to fields not named in `fields` at a boundary.

Signature.description: What a function, an effect or an entry takes and returns.

Site.description:
A node's address: the code it belongs to and the chain of
[`Node::children`] indexes that reaches it from that code's body.

A site is derived from the document and is never written by a host
(`K-ID-004`). An empty chain addresses the body itself.

SourceLanguage.description: The language of source, independent of a generated-source format version.

SourceOperandType.description:
What source analysis knows about an operand, independently of runtime values.
Functions retain only their known result; objects and arrays distinguish proven
representation from annotated fields or elements.

Span.description: UTF-8 byte offsets in authored or printed source.

oneOf.description: Python calls carry positional arguments, keywords and the active exception.
The document's `main`, as a session cell.
One of the document's entries, by name.
A retained callable with its captured initial environment.

Timestamp.description:
An instant: nanoseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, with no zone
(`K-VAL-009`). Stored as its decimal spelling.

oneOf.description: Every value.

Every value `Any` admits that holds no closure, function reference,
dialect token holding one, task or handle anywhere in it: data, as a
JSON-schema slot describes it (`K-EFF-002`). It serves where `Any` is
expected; `Any` does not serve where it is.

An integer or a float. In an effect's result this is the bare number
the document's number policy decodes (`K-EFF-006`).
A tuple of exactly these member types.
A text that is one of these.
A closure or a function reference that takes and returns these.
A task handle whose task ends with this.
A handle of this host kind.
A value of any one of these types. Two or more, none itself a union.

Unit.description: The code a node belongs to.

oneOf.description: The document's `main`.
A declared function of the document.

The kernel-code body of an authored or build-owned library function.
Nested helper closures retain this owning identity and their site path.

WrittenSignature.description: The source spelling of a callable's public signature, without dialect state.

description:
How a new run starts ([`lash_kernel_vm::CellStart`], less its owner
binding, which the protocol's `Start` carries), and the effects it
performs as reads ([`EffectModes`]).

host.description: The host's read-only bindings a cell's `main` starts with.

reads.description: The effects the run performs as reads (`K-EFF-012`).

session.description: The carried session a cell opens in place.

target.description: The entry to run; `None` runs the document's `main`.
